description: This file implements report merging functionality for Playwright test reports, including report extraction, event parsing, report merging, patching, and modernization. It defines functions and classes for handling report files, patching event data, and managing report versions.

classes.name: UniqueFileNameGenerator
classes.description: Generates unique file names to avoid conflicts when extracting report files.

classes.name: IdsPatcher
classes.description: Patches test IDs in events to ensure uniqueness across merged reports, optionally salting IDs that are used in multiple blobs.

classes.name: AttachmentPathPatcher
classes.description: Adjusts attachment paths in events to point to the resource directory.

classes.name: PathSeparatorPatcher
classes.description: Replaces path separators in event data to match the current platform's separator.

classes.name: GlobalErrorPatcher
classes.description: Prefixes error messages and stacks with a bot name prefix.

classes.name: JsonEventPatchers
classes.description: Manages a collection of event patchers and applies them to events.

classes.name: BlobModernizer
classes.description: Converts older report event formats to the current format, supporting version upgrades.

methods.name: createMergedReport
methods.description: Main function to merge multiple report shards into a single report, handling extraction, event parsing, patching, and dispatching.

methods.name: parseCommonEvents
methods.description: Parses and filters common metadata events from report JSON lines.

methods.name: parseTestEvents
methods.description: Parses and filters test-related events from report JSON lines.

methods.name: splitBufferLines
methods.description: Splits a buffer into lines based on newline characters.

methods.name: extractAndParseReports
methods.description: Extracts report files from zip archives, parses events, and gathers metadata.

methods.name: findMetadata
methods.description: Extracts report metadata from the first event, verifying version compatibility.

methods.name: mergeEvents
methods.description: Merges multiple report event streams into a combined set, including configuration, project, and end events.

methods.name: mergeConfigureEvents
methods.description: Combines multiple configuration events into a single configuration, handling root directory overrides.

methods.name: mergeConfigs
methods.description: Merges two configuration objects into one.

methods.name: mergeEndEvents
methods.description: Creates a final 'onEnd' event summarizing the merged report results.

methods.name: sortedShardFiles
methods.description: Lists and sorts report shard files in a directory.
